alerts.message: TRITON 0020-048E slipped one day on the US end. New York ETD 2026-10-08 -> 2026-10-09 and Norfolk ETD 2026-10-10 -> 2026-10-11. Yantian ETD holds at 2026-09-04 and Savannah ETD holds at 2026-10-04. Yantian to Savannah transit widened 28d -> 29d; the nearest AUE proforma widened with it (29d -> 30d), so the one-day advantage is unchanged.

Unknown code AUG surfaced on the Gulf lanes: n=3 on CNNGB-USHOU (ONE HUMEN 101E 16 Sep, CONTI CORTESIA 014E 20 Sep, MOL CREATION 103E 04 Sep) and n=2 on CNYTN-USHOU. n>=3 puts it in the NEW SERVICE branch, not the extra-loader branch. The Evergreen vessel-schedule drill-down on ONE HUMEN settles it: LINE: reads 'Asia-U.S. GULF Service (AUG)' and the vessel runs matched 100E/100W and 101E/101W legs, i.e. a full proforma round trip with a westbound return. This is a registry gap, not ad-hoc capacity. Holding it out of serviceRegistry until a second run confirms, per the detection rules; promote next run.

alerts.message: ONE walled on the very first lane this run, not after the usual three. Route Finder (point-to-point-schedule, nextWeekValue=56) returned 'Total 0 results' for CNYTN-USNYC with 'Thanks for Your Patience' present in the page text, which is the documented false-empty. No ONE lanes were covered. Separately, ONE is showing a maintenance notice: eCommerce applications unavailable 6 Sep 2026 17:00-21:00 GMT+8. Premier Alliance EC1-EC4 therefore has no coverage this run, since Yang Ming and HMM remain blocked and both normally surface through ONE.

CMA CGM worked this run for the first time since 2026-08-27. The routing-finder autocomplete populated normally, the search submitted via the page's own searchSchedules button, and no DataDome 403 appeared. One lane pulled (CNYTN-USNYC): SAX 4, TWS 5, CBX 4, all registry-known. Removed from carriersBlocked. Only one DataDome POST consumed, so the quota shared with liner-tracker-market-refresh is essentially untouched.

The documented seed-then-replay requirement did not hold this run. The origin autocomplete dropdown never rendered at all (no suggestion list in the DOM after real typing), yet setting tvs2OriAC / tvs2DesAC plus both _hideValue fields programmatically, calling checkACViaUSCA on each and then frmSubmit, navigated correctly every time. frmSubmit returns before the navigation fires, so the caller must wait about 9s and then read the results page rather than expecting a synchronous result. Worth re-testing next run before rewriting the skill.

New symptom: ShipmentLink drops the TCP connection (ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED, page falls back to the browser error page and localStorage becomes inaccessible) after roughly five point-to-point queries in quick succession. It recovers after about 60 seconds of idle. This cost the planned second pass from 2026-10-02 and several lanes. Pace queries with a cooldown next run.

Lanes not covered this run. Evergreen: CNSHA-USSAV, CNSHA-USHOU, CNNGB-USSAV, KRPUS-USNYC, KRPUS-USSAV, KRPUS-USHOU, VNCMT-USSAV, VNCMT-USHOU, and the entire second pass from 2026-10-02. Hapag-Lloyd: CNNGB-USSAV, CNNGB-USHOU, KRPUS-USSAV, KRPUS-USHOU, and Cai Mep on every lane (the API rejects both VNCMT and VNTOT with HTTP 400, so Hapag has no Cai Mep coverage at all). CMA CGM: everything except CNYTN-USNYC. MSC/ZIM: everything except CNYTN-USNYC and CNYTN-USHOU. ONE: all lanes. Maersk: not attempted, see carriersBlocked.
